title: Iman di Likot Tahta .
intro: Na jiwa-jiwa nyang geu-uji kon lé apui atawa banjir, tapi lé teukanan nyang lambat-lambat udép lam meuligoe sidroe tiran. Tokoh nyoe jidong bak binéh sidroe peunguasa nyang jiklaim keutuhanan ateueh umat awaknyan, teuma deungon cara rahsia jimat ubak iman ubak Allah nyang Saboh nyang Beutôi. Watée bakti awaknyan ka meuteumé, deurita teuka — teuma meunan cit ngon janji ilahi. Jeut neukira soe nyoe?
clues: Lon tinggai dimiyueb bubong peunguasa nanggroe lon nyang paleng meukuasa, lam posisi nyang hana le nyang jeuet jibayangkan.
Pasangan ulôn geudong dikeue rakyat dan geupeugah droe geuh sibagoe dewa — teuma até ulôn na kheueh atra Tuhan nyang Nyang Saboh nyang Beutôi.
Lon bisik-bisik doa lam rahsia, teumakot keu hukoman nyang teuka keu mandum nyang meulawan ngon pasangan lon.
Watèë iman ulôn ka teupeuhah, ulôn ka djidjak drop dan djisiksa — bah that pih meunan lidah ulôn hana tom djipeugah saboh kata njang hana meuiman.
Ulôn plông haté keu Tuhanku, lôn lakèe rumoh dalam syuruga, jiôh nibak sigala buët salah.
Lon nakeuh Asiya bint Muzahim — peurumoh Fir'un nyang meulawan ngon Musa ngon Harun.

identity.label: Soe Lon?
options: Asiya bint muzahim (Istri Fir'un) .
Hawwa (Hawa), inong phon
Sarah, peurumoh phon Nabi Ibrahim
Hajar, mak nibak Isma’il .
Mak Maryam (peurumoh Imran) .

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Meutahan siksaan kareuna hana geutem tulak iman .
Meutheun lam pruet eungkot rayeuk .
Peugot kapai nyang rayeuk that keu geupeulheuh droe nibak banjir .
Teungoh jitiek lam apui nyang teungoh meuapui-apui .
Meusaksikan perpisahan saboh laot nyang rayeuk .
trial.answer: Meutahan siksaan kareuna hana geutem tulak iman .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Saboh rumoh nyang geupeudöng keu awaknyan lam syuruga .
Saboh tungkat nyang meuubah jeuet keu uleue .
Saboh kapai nyang jiba tiep-tiep makhluk nyang meupasang-pasang .
Saboh aneuk leumo méuh nyang jiseumah lé saboh bansa .
Saboh glang nyang geungui keu peutaloe sidroe pahlawan raksasa .
location.answer: Saboh rumoh nyang geupeudöng keu awaknyan lam syuruga .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Dimuliakan deungon teumpat tinggai lam syuruga disampeng ureueng nyang saleh .
Leumoh dimiyueb gelombang meusajan ngon pasokan awaknyan .
Tutong lam apui tapi seulamat le campur tangan ilahi .
Ditelan le makhluk rayeuk lheuh nyan dibuang u darat .
Jeut keu ureung paleng kaya bak masa nyan .
outcome.answer: Dimuliakan deungon teumpat tinggai lam syuruga disampeng ureueng nyang saleh .

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
